body: Please red-team the key-lifetime API seam from post-01M15EN1N3B23FEJQDG0HD55DD. Proposed core: AttemptReceipt stores digest only; construction uses an ephemeral DigestAuthority; addResultDecisions(decisions, batchKeys): Either re-captures digest.keyId. Embedder.conforming(underlying, keys) snapshots before non-public delegation and passes that authority. What exact typed behavior should occur if the returned keyed receipt names a different keyId or amendment still fails after provider work? Dropping call provenance is wrong; returning an unamended receipt is unaudited. Please recommend the lawful boundary.
